title: agalinis purpurea var. neoscotia
intro: Agalinis purpurea var. neoscotia, commonly known as Purple Gerard's or Purple Agalinis, is a perennial plant species in the Orobanchaceae family, which is a type of parasitic flowering plant that obtains its nutrients by attaching itself to the roots of other plants. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues, fever, and infections, due to its potential health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Agalinis purpurea var. neoscotia include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve coughs and congestion, and its immunomodulatory effects, which can enhance the body's immune response. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, phenylethanoid glycosides, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
